title: 16 NV2A color logic-op spec oracle (expected_fail Metal+GL)
purpose: Render a 4x4 grid where each cell exercises one of the 16 NV2A color logic ops (CLEAR / AND / AND_REVERSE / COPY / AND_INVERTED / NOOP / XOR / OR / NOR / EQUIV / INVERT / OR_REVERSE / COPY_INVERTED / OR_INVERTED / NAND / SET). DST=mid-gray 0x808080 (uniform clear), SRC=(0x40, 0xC0, 0x80) with intentionally varied per-channel bit patterns. Expected per-channel = src <op> dst computed bitwise. Real Xbox hardware expected to PASS; xemu-GL and xemu-Metal do NOT implement logic ops (both treat the ROP as COPY regardless of NV2A_SET_LOGIC_OP_* per Codex 2026-05-20 confirmation), so both renderers are declared expected_fail in this manifest. The harness records those cells as 'expected_fail' (not 'fail') so the rotation isn't gated. This XBE serves as the SPEC for what each renderer needs when logic-op support is implemented; when the renderer-side fix lands, remove the entry from expected_fail_renderers.
